newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank sees profits rising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank sees profits rising in 1997.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Tuesday it expected a further good increase in profits this year and said its business had gone better than planned at the start of 1997.

Management Board Chairman Albert Schmidt told reporters the bank's operating profits would show another significant increase this year. Earlier, the bank announced an 18 percent rise in 1996 operating profit to around 1.6 billion marks ($939.4 million).
Schmidt declined to name the bank's precise profit goals.
Vereinsbank also said it did not have any current plans to increase its capital.
Its net profits, which were not reported earlier, rose some 30 percent in 1996, the bank added.
